source_snapshot.criteria: Behavior matches the LED function defined by the system specification.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally matches this LED type but lacks target identity, safe insertion and cleanup controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact physical/logical map, visual exclusivity, stop/clear state and storage-health checks.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Present, Access/Busy, RAID-fail and Rebuild use different triggers; this row alone explicitly commands Locate/UID.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The target and non-target bays must be observed through baseline, assert and clear so a correct CLI return cannot hide wrong physical mapping.

original_test_intent: Verify that the supported Locate/UID command for the selected NVMe adapter/drive illuminates only the platform-defined physical target indicator and can be cleared without storage errors.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and maps the exact SSD, the agent issues the approved vendor assert and clear commands to stable selectors, and both command and physical target/non-target evidence are preserved.
manual_activity: User approves mapping and vendor command; qualified operator inserts the SSD and records target/non-target LEDs; agent asserts and clears only the exact target.
required_inputs: Locate/UID LED color, cadence, timing and clear behavior
Stable SSD serial/NGUID to adapter/controller/enclosure/slot map
Vendor CLI/version and exact assert/readback/clear syntax
Supported insertion and data/RAID recovery procedure
Qualified operator, camera, OOB and stuck-Locate recovery
safety_requirements: Revalidate stable physical mapping before every command
Confirm command is indicator-only and does not alter power, RAID or data
Preserve baseline logs and observe neighboring bays
Stop on wrong/multiple LEDs, ambiguous target, failed clear, storage/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not guess controller/slot or issue locate-all
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline mapping and storage health
Run one approved target-specific assert, readback and clear sequence
Record outputs/timestamps and confirm final cleared state with operator evidence
Do not insert hardware, claim visual proof, command other slots, recover automatically or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mapping, tool syntax, LED matrix and recovery
Provide qualified operator and own failed-clear/wrong-target recovery
Review target/non-target and clear evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Locate operation matches the intended trigger, but placeholder controller/enclosure/slot values and lack of clear-state/non-target proof make the example unsafe and incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned vendor CLI with stable verified controller/enclosure/slot selectors for one assert/readback/clear cycle, paired with operator photos of target and adjacent bays.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, adapter selection, Locate LED check and source 10/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise baseline, exclusive single-target assert and verified clear with complete controller/storage evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity and residual-state cleanup without changing the intended Locate function.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation controls and records state; the operator remains authoritative for physical illumination.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller/enclosure slot numbering can differ from chassis labels and may change after service; mapping must be current.

project_override_considerations: If Locate is exposed through SES, NVMe-MI, Redfish or another controller interface, only the project-approved component identity and command semantics apply.
expected_evidence: Pinned CLI/version and stable serial-adapter-controller-enclosure-slot map
Exact assert/readback/clear outputs, exit codes and timestamps
Final cleared/restored state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All sources identify Locate/UID behavior; GPT V2 strengthens target and cleanup controls without changing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor command, mapping and operator are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes Locate an exact-target, exclusive-illumination and verified-clear transaction rather than a placeholder command.
independent_technical_reasoning: The controller can acknowledge Locate even when its logical slot map points to the wrong chassis bay, and a stale Locate bit can mislead later service. Therefore command success, physical target exclusivity and explicit deassertion are independent acceptance checkpoints tied to current stable identity.
